items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall ruled out with thigh injury.
items.implication: Sit; Jets RB committee or backup elevates heavily for carries/snaps.
items.opportunity: Increased snap/carry/red-zone share for remaining Jets RBs.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers is active and will make 2026 season debut vs. Saints (was Q/knee, ETR/Levitan projected IN).
items.implication: Strong start candidate; full TE1 role likely on return.

items.text: Dolphins RB De'Von Achane ruled out vs. Chiefs with knee injury; HC Hafley: early eval 'does not sound very optimistic' / major concern.
items.why: Knee injury mid-game then downgraded; coach pessimism on severity.
items.implication: Sit immediately; multi-week risk elevated. Handcuff/backup RBs surge in value.
items.opportunity: Full backfield opportunity shift for remaining MIA RBs; check goal-line/third-down roles.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers is active vs. Cowboys after GTD/hamstring workout that looked good; Rapoport notes likely limited usage.
items.why: Pregame workout positive; team decision to activate though not fully counting on full role earlier.
items.implication: Startable if rostered; limited snaps/routes possible. Prefer over pure backups.
items.opportunity: Still primary WR but monitor snap share and red-zone; reverse prior Bateman/Andrews boosts.

items.text: Berry: Risky but if Zay Flowers active for Baltimore he's active for me; start over Bateman.
Steelers RB Jaylen Warren active (was Q/shoulder; ETR expected, Levitan projected IN).
items.implication: Start with confidence; volume secure especially with Dowdle out.
items.opportunity: Elevated carries/snaps/third-down; Berry noted potential bump.

items.text: Jets WR Adonai Mitchell (finger, Q/GTD) expected inactive; Levitan lists depth: Garrett Wilson, Isaiah Williams, Jamaal Pritchett, Sterling Shepard, Malik McLain + TE Kenyon Sadiq slot/wide.
items.why: Fowler source + Levitan confirmation; was team-high 12 targets prior week.
items.implication: Wilson clear WR1 with expanded opportunity; Sadiq hybrid boost.
items.opportunity: Higher target/route share for Wilson and remaining WRs/TE; depth chart clear.

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore (shoulder, Q) expected/active vs. Chargers; Levitan/ETR projected in but limited.
items.why: Source expected to play; confirmed in actives.
items.opportunity: Still solid target share if near full; Keon Coleman also up.

items.text: Levitan/ETR initially projecting Zay Flowers OUT (hamstring) in models despite GTD; keep late-swap for Bateman/Andrews DFS; later ACTIVE overrides. Moore limited IN, Mitchell OUT.
items.why: Team not counting on him; conservative for main slate.
items.implication: DFS pivot ready; actual ACTIVE is upgrade from projs.
items.opportunity: If limited, still targets but reduced; reverse full OUT beneficiaries.
items.conflict: Actual ACTIVE vs initial OUT proj

items.text: ETR Sunday AM summary: Flowers GTD (not counting on); Spears hopeful GTD; Expected: Warren/Pittman, Barkley/Smith, Bowers, Evans, Coker, Coleman. Q: Parkinson trending right, Bagent.
items.why: Compiled weekend reports; aligns Schefter later confirms.
items.implication: Lock in expected players; hold Flowers flex/GTD.
items.opportunity: Full roles for Barkley/Smith/Bowers/Evans/Warren; Coker up with Legette out.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins OUT second straight (hamstring); decent chance return Week 4 vs. DAL. Schultz elevated.
Berry loves Derrick Henry vs. DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop 88.5; DAL 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.why: Elite matchup + prop line signals heavy volume.

items.text: Berry loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches + 15% target share both games; RB7 util; PIT 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
Berry loves Chris Olave vs. LV: double-digit targets both games, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high 18.7 ypr to WRs.
Berry loves Dalton Schultz @ IND: 28% target share last week with Collins out; IND 4th-most TE yards allowed.
items.why: Elevated role + TE-friendly matchup (Collins still OUT).
items.opportunity: 28%+ target share / high routes while Collins out.

items.text: Berry hates Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX: 31% snaps/5 touches post-fumble; JAX allows only 55 rush yds/g, 3.2 YPC.
items.why: Lost role post-fumble + tough run D.
items.opportunity: Henderson 65% snaps/out-touched 16-5 remainder of prior game.

items.text: Berry hates Travis Etienne vs. LV: only 49% RB touches/38% 3rd-down snaps even with Kamara; role not there (RB37 util).
Berry hates Terry McLaurin vs. SEA: SEA fewest FP to WRs, 7.9 ypr allowed; WAS lowest implied total (17).
items.why: Brutal matchup + low team total (Daniels out, Mariota).
items.implication: Sit despite prior Mariota chemistry (25% TS).
